answer.rationale: With the line at 94% of committed volume and no buffer, a vendor switch (memory_c2's cost win) or adding a second source (memory_c3) carries onboarding/allocation risk this cycle and exceeds our single-decision capacity. The contract expires in 14 days, so deferral (memory_c5) is not viable. Renegotiating with the incumbent (memory_c4, memory_c6) directly targets the 18% mandate via benchmarking and multi-year volume pricing while preserving the stable integration that has held across two cycles (memory_c1). I want to verify c2 and c4 before committing, to confirm the magnitude of the switch savings I'm forgoing and the negotiation leverage that previously moved the incumbent.
